highlights: Contact facing keeps your brush off the far wall of a slot or the other side of a fold
Engrave and Crease Line keep smooth walls when one stroke runs up and down the same line
Dense Micro levels show Undo, Redo and Move at once, with fewer pauses as strokes start and end
Shift with the Paint brush smooths every channel you paint, across UV seams too
Texture painting works on more Android phones and tablets
